title: App Store Optimization (ASO) Basics
deck: ASO is a free traffic channel that's hard to measure. Operate it on three axes: (1) metadata optimization, (2) visual A/B testing, (3) a keyword scorecard.

chips.label: Tools · App Store Connect / Play Console

summary: ASO's core metric is Conversion Rate (impression→install) = Install / Impression. ~25% is decent, 35%+ is excellent. Metadata earns keyword impressions; screenshots and the icon decide click→install conversion.

rows: 1 core keyword + brand. e.g. 'OO Shop – Fashion Shopping'
High search weight on iOS. On Android, low search weight but affects conversion
iOS only. Comma-separated, no spaces. Mixed languages allowed
Very high search weight on Android. Put core keywords in the first 3 lines
iOS only. Changeable without an app update — use for seasonal messaging

items: iOS: use Product Page Optimization (PPO). Up to 3 variants, 50/50/50 traffic split, allow 14–30 days for significance.
Android: Play Console Store Listing Experiments. Up to 4 variants, test one field at a time.
Test priority: icon → first screenshot → video preview → remaining screenshots. The first screenshot has the largest conversion impact (35%+).

content.html: Prioritize keywords by the ratio of Search Score (volume) to Difficulty Score (competition): Priority = Search Score / Difficulty Score. Attack keywords with Priority ≥ 1.5 first.

content.title: PPO results aren't statistically significant
content.html: Under ~1,000 daily impressions, significance can take 60+ days. Test bigger swings (a completely different concept), or use ASA to force traffic volume during the test.

content.title: Keyword rankings suddenly drop
content.html: Possible causes: a new competitor, an Apple/Google algorithm update (roughly quarterly), or a spike in negative reviews. Below a 4.2-star rating, search weighting is penalized. Prioritize review replies + bug fixes.
